availability.selection_rule: Use when reach, holding capacity, spindle adjustment, mounting stiffness, and opening clearance suit the fixture.

source.note: Exact user-supplied 14-component STEP is bundled. Its saved pose is tilted and is not a verified closed operating pose.

canonical_frame.origin: centre of the base front edge on the mounting plane
canonical_frame.x_axis: positive from base toward clamp pad
canonical_frame.y_axis: positive across base to the left when looking from handle toward pad
canonical_frame.z_axis: positive away from the mounting plane

mounting.pattern_status: Centres of the four obround slots measured from bundled STEP; source variant needs physical confirmation.

fixture_plate_preparation.operation: laser cut pilot hole, then tap M5 x 0.8
fixture_plate_preparation.note: Confirm kerf, heat-affected edge, tap condition, and physical clamp fit before production.

mounting.drawing_dimensions_note: Existing longitudinal_pitch_mm=26.2, transverse_pitch_mm=22 and front_row_offset_from_base_front_mm=6.3 describe the drawing, not the bundled CAD pattern. Use hole_centres_canonical_mm for this asset.

standard_mount_plate.note: Shop standard clamp cap for this clamp: 50 mm along the arm x 60 mm across, centred on the hole pattern. 5 mm ligament (1 x plate thickness) applies to this cap only; 60 mm across leaves room for cheek tab slots beside the base.

closed_geometry.arm_pivot_status: derived from manufacturer side-view dimensions; use for placement and planning, not as complete linkage kinematics
closed_geometry.contact_point_note: The pad contact point moves along the spindle axis; its exact Z coordinate depends on spindle adjustment and workpiece/support geometry.

envelope.note: The STEP bounding box is orientation-dependent and should not replace the canonical mounting dimensions.

motion.verification_rule: Use a conservative opening envelope unless intermediate linkage poses are derived and collision-checked.

capacity.warning: Holding capacity is not applied clamping force.

verification.mounting_pattern_source: Measured bundled STEP slot centres; drawing dimensions retained separately; physical variant unconfirmed.
verification.closed_pose_geometry_source: Nominal drawing dimensions only; the bundled STEP is tilted and has no verified closed-pose derivation.

asset.note: Canonical transform is rigid, measured from base mounting plane raw Y=-2, front X=0, centre raw Z=-17.5201010126775. Preserve all occurrence placements. Do not rotate the entire clamp to make its spindle vertical.

mount_height_policy.basis: Workshop default requested by user: mounting face level with clamping surface. This is not a universal manufacturer requirement.
mount_height_policy.measurement: Signed mounting-face minus actual clamping-surface height along surface_normal; measured after STEP export.
mount_height_policy.exception: A different signed offset requires current hardware_pose and clamp_seating evidence for this clamp, including spindle adjustment and locked linkage.
mount_height_policy.operation_note: Equal height does not establish spindle travel, contact or toggle lock.
